thread:
mike.t: Heads-up: planning a short-schema change in the 00:30 UTC change window. Index on users(email_domain) to speed up tenant signups. Expect a brief quiesce (~90s) for the share lock.

release-bot: NOTE: Please follow the deploy checklist: pin app version, run canary, set migration lease, and have rollback commands ready.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: migration=20260321_users_email_domain_idx_add, target=prod, window=2026-03-21T00:30Z-00:40Z, lease=db-mig-99.

sara: Is the index CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY? Any backfill strategy?

mike.t: Yes CONCURRENTLY. Backfill will be handled by the job service, chunked by id % 16. DDL still acquires short locks; plan is: 1) pin app at 1.14.2, 2) enable write quiesce for signup path, 3) issue CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, 4) resume writes, 5) kick off rate-limited backfill.

jordan: Add abort triggers: lock wait > 120s, replica lag > 1s, or >5% increase in p99 write latency.

ops-ci: Runbook check: Add live query to monitor for CREATE INDEX lock holders: 
```
SELECT now(), pid, wait_event_type, wait_event, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE query ~ 'CREATE INDEX' OR query LIKE '%CREATE INDEX%';
```
Also watch pg_stat_replication lag.

sara: I'll own the latency watch during window. Who toggles quiesce?

mike.t: I'll toggle the feature-flag. curl example: curl -X POST https://ff.redwood/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"signup_write_quiesce","value":true}'

release-bot: Canary directive: run canary in eu-west-1 at 10% traffic for 2 minutes before main. Deploy-bot will block handoff until canary passes.

sara: Canary metrics look good (p95/p99 within baseline). Proceeding to main.

deploy-bot: Migration started: migration=20260321_users_email_domain_idx_add, pid=91022. Logs: https://logs.redwood/migrations/91022.

mike.t: Starting quiesce in 7s, posting markers.

sara: quiesce start ts=1715510007. baseline p99 writes=380ms.

mike.t: Issued CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY on users(email_domain).

ops-ci: Observed transient lock wait ~25s, replication lag stayed <200ms. Nothing crossing abort thresholds.

mike.t: Index DDL complete. Releasing quiesce. unquiesce ts=1715510052. p99 now 365ms.

jordan: Kicking the async backfill with 16 shards, rate-limit 80r/s, job_id=bf-20260321-001.

deploy-bot: Migration complete: SUCCESS. Post-deploy checks passed (error rates normal, replication healthy).

mike.t: Post-deploy notes: keep index monitored for 24h. Keep app pin for 48h. If regressions: 1) pause backfill, 2) set signup_write_quiesce=true, 3) run drop via safe job: psql -c 'DROP INDEX IF EXISTS users_email_domain_idx'

sara: ACK. Marking the thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
